C. I. D.
I. C. REG
No. 209
Date 29/3/16

Shanghai Municipal Police.

Central Police Station.

March 25th 1916.

REPORT ON Letter Soliciting Contribution to Revolutionary Funds,

Made by D.S.Givens Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector

Sir,
Regarding attached, I beg to report that inquiries go to
show that there is a rebel organization known as the
Brave Iron and Blood Society, of which a man named
Dong Ping Kun ( 董秉均 ) is a prominent member. The
headquarters of this society are said to be at No. 32
Rue Amiral Bayle, French Town.

I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
H. Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Cheif Detective Inspector.

CM /
Krn

Translation of a letter received by Cho Lan Fong 祝蘭芳
on 20th March 1916.

To Messrs Ching Tsai, Lan Fong, and Say Siang.

Gentlemen:
Although we have not the pleasure of seeing
you, we have long appreciated your generosity.
Having successfully attained our object in strengthening
the people's rights in the year of 1911, the members
of our party gave up their positions in order that
they might devote their attention to improving the
material existence of our people. It was then our
hope that the country would soon become strong and
people would enjoy the blessings of a Republic.
However Yuan under the name of Republicanism
has adopted the policy of despotism. He removed
his opponents and misruled the country resulting in
corruption in the internal administration and
difficulties in diplomatic negotiations.
Hence we started the revolution in 1913 but the citizens,
then not knowing the treachery of Yuan, assisted the
"tiger" which caused a failure in the revolution.
What then was our sufferings?
We were obliged to start the revolution in view of
the misrule of Yuan and in the hope of saving our
people. Yuan seeing the speedy suppression of the
late insurrection and the strong support of his
adherents who have been scattered over the country
making opposition impossible, then dreamed of making
himself Emperor. He has sold the country. In addition
to the twenty one demands which he has recognised
he offers the concession of the articles mentioned in
Group 5 as an exchange for the recognition of the
Monarchy. Internally he utilized the military men in
fabricating the opinion of the people in favour of the
change.
Now Generals Dong and Tsar have declared independence
in the south west and are endeavouring to preserve
the Republic by means of iron and blood.
The enemy is being besieged in Szechuen and the
Yunnan soldiers are entering Hunan and attacking
them in the rear. Following the Kwangsi independence
came the defeats of the enemy's army.
Our influence is growing stronger and sympathy is felt
whenever our army passes. The rich help us with money
and the strong assist us with their strength.
We have long known you as being generous, and patriotic
and very anxious to see the restoration of the Republic
in the East Asia. The contributions from various
places mostly go to the needs in the south west
and therefore financial difficulties are being felt in
this province. We hope that you being enthusiastically
interested in national affairs, will not neglect
your native place, the Kiangsu province. We request
that you will within three days jointly raise $100,000.00
and give to us for distribution so as to enable us
to speedily carry out our aim to a successful issue.
As soon as the new Republican Government is established
we will mortgage the first Debenture Bonds as a pledge
the amount you lend us.
Your gain is the privilege of patriots in lending us
the money while we receive the support of a loan most
needed in such a time when we act in a revolution.
Thus we enjoy the benefits alike. We presume
you will not refuse the loan.
If you grant our request please immediately publish an
advertisement in Sinwanpao and or Tsung Wah Sin Pao
pages.zh:
祝蘭芳（Cho Lan Fong）于1916年3月20日收到信件的译文。

致 景斋、兰芳、思祥 诸位先生。

诸位先生：
虽未蒙晤面，但久仰诸位慷慨大义。吾党于1911年成功实现巩固民权之目标后，党员们皆辞去职位，以便专心致力于改善我国民众的物质生活。当时我们期望国家能迅速强盛，人民能享受共和之福。
然而，袁世凯假借共和之名，行专制之实。他铲除异己，治国无方，导致内政腐败，外交谈判陷入困境。
因此，我们于1913年发动革命，但当时民众不知袁氏奸诈，反而助纣为虐（协助“虎”），致使革命失败。
彼时我等遭受何种苦难？
鉴于袁世凯的暴政，并为拯救吾国同胞，我们不得不再次发动革命。袁世凯见前次起义被迅速镇压，且其党羽遍布全国，势力强大，令反对成为不可能，便妄图称帝。他出卖国家。除了承认“二十一条”要求外，他还以承认第五组条款中的各项权利作为交换，以求对其君主制的认可。在内部，他利用军人伪造民意，制造支持改制的舆论。
如今，唐将军与蔡将军已在西南宣布独立，正努力以铁血手段维护共和。
敌军在四川被围困，滇军进入湖南，从后方攻击敌军。继广西独立之后，敌军接连战败。
我方影响力日益增强，军队所到之处，皆获同情。富者出资相助，强者出力相援。
我们久闻诸位慷慨爱国，并迫切希望看到东亚共和制度的恢复。各地的捐款多用于西南方面的需求，因此本省面临财政困难。我们希望诸位热心国事，勿忘故乡江苏省。恳请诸位在三日内共同筹集十万元（$100,000.00），交予我们分配，以便我们能迅速达成目标，取得圆满成功。
一旦新共和政府成立，我们将以首批公债债券作为抵押，担保诸位借予我们的款项。
诸位的收益在于享有爱国者借款给我们的特权，而我们在革命行动之际，获得了最急需的贷款支持。
如此，双方均享其利。想必诸位不会拒绝此项借款。
如蒙应允，请立即在《新闻报》（Sinwanpao）或《中华新报》（Tsung Wah Sin Pao）上刊登广告
